name: Caster
steps: 1 Step 1 : Open the Caster site Go to caster.trade and read the homepage description of the prediction-native chain and its orderbook.
2 Step 2 : Join the waitlist Press the Join Waitlist button on the homepage to ask for early access. As of 2 November 2026 it is the only sign-up the site offers.
3 Step 3 : Read how markets are priced Read the homepage sections on the Caster Liquidity Pool and the fee structure, which say takers pay fees and makers earn rebates.
4 Step 4 : Return for trading access Check caster.trade again to see whether trading has opened, since the homepage gives no launch date.
what: There is no Caster airdrop to take part in as of 2 November 2026, and the project's site announces none.
